name: kiu-admission-portal
description: Official digital admission and career placement platform for Kampala International University (KIU)
author: KIU ICT Department

scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'].forEach(f=>{try{fs.unlinkSync(f)}catch(e){}});if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent.includes('pnpm')){console.error('\x1b[31mERROR: KIU Admission Portal requires pnpm instead of npm/yarn\x1b[0m');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter "!@workspace/mockup-sandbox" --if-present run build
scripts.setup: pnpm install && cd apps/flask-api && pip install -r requirements.txt
